title: Add WAF to a diagram without WAF
reference: Adds WAF 3.0 as a badge on the ALB (or ESA) in cloud-native mode, with no new hop in the path and nothing else changed.

title: WAF requested when it is already there
reference: Says WAF already protects the ALB and changes nothing.

title: Swap the app tier to Kubernetes
reference: Swaps the ECS app tier and its Auto Scaling for an ACK cluster across both zones while keeping the existing connections (ALB ingress, Tair, PolarDB, OpenSearch, OSS, RocketMQ, NAT, SLS); ACR is a plus.

turns.ask: Run the app tier on Kubernetes instead of ECS.

title: Add a data warehouse
reference: Adds DTS or DataWorks sync from PolarDB into MaxCompute, Hologres or AnalyticDB, plus Quick BI dashboards, without touching the existing store.

turns.ask: Add a data warehouse so the business team gets BI dashboards on orders.

title: Remove the AI assistant
reference: Removes the shopping assistant (Model Studio) and its vector store with their edges, and nothing else.

turns.ask: Drop the AI shopping assistant, we don't need it anymore.

title: Remove, then restore a component
reference: Turn 1 removes the assistant; turn 2 restores the assistant node and its edges with the same ids (and the vector store if it was removed).

turns.ask: Remove the AI shopping assistant for now.
Actually, bring the assistant back exactly as it was.

title: Make it multi-region for disaster recovery
reference: Adds a Jakarta region with a standby stack (ALB, compute and a database replica through PolarDB global database or DTS), OSS cross-region replication and GTM or ESA failover; keeps the Singapore stack.

turns.ask: Make it multi-region for disaster recovery: Singapore stays primary and Jakarta is the standby.

title: Make it cheaper
reference: Removes redundant or premium parts (Anti-DDoS Proxy behind ESA, which already mitigates DDoS), right-sizes (for example RDS instead of PolarDB, or SAE), keeps search, images, cache and the assistant, and explains the trade-offs without inventing prices.

turns.ask: This is too expensive for us. Make it cheaper without losing the core features.
